description: Change a Wix blog post that already exists: title, body, excerpt, slug, tags, categories, cover image, search title and description, or its status (publish a draft, unpublish to draft, or schedule with a future date). Only the fields passed change. An edit to a post that is already live is published too. The reply is Wix's own copy. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in, for THIS CALL ONLY: an id or exact name from list_brands, needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

postId.description: the post id post_to_wix or list_wix_posts returned

text.description: the new body: replaces the old one

name: update_wix_post
title: Edit a Wix blog post
